lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb2Fe14Mo2 (TbFe7Mo) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Fe and Mo are each surrounded by 12 geometric neighbors (Fe: 8 Fe + 4 Mo; Mo: 12 Fe), while Tb has 12 Fe neighbors, with distances ranging from 2.6352 to 2.7507 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Fe–Fe and Fe–Mo 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Fe–Tb pairs sharing edges.
